evals.prompt: wanna add solvapay to our product but not sure if we need hosted checkout, sdk on our api, or a paid mcp server for agents. stack is next.js plus an experimental mcp worker
evals.expected_output: Agent loads the solvapay router skill, asks one disambiguation question or routes using the intent matrix by skill id, and names the correct surface skill without implementing integration code.
assertions: Agent references the solvapay router SKILL.md or intent matrix
Agent routes by namespaced skill id (solvapay/<surface>) — not ../ file paths
Agent does not start scaffolding or writing paywall code before routing

evals.prompt: paywall my rest api with solvapay — express backend, no mcp involved.
evals.expected_output: Agent routes to solvapay/app-integration for REST/web paywall, not solvapay/create-mcp-app.
assertions: Handoff target is solvapay/app-integration, not solvapay/create-mcp-app
Agent does not assume greenfield MCP scaffold or OpenAPI-to-MCP flow

evals.prompt: monetize my mcp server with a hosted no-code proxy — just paste the server url and gate tools without code
evals.expected_output: Agent routes to Managed MCP (console path), names the surface, points at provider console and docs (/no-code-mcp/overview or quick-start), and does not scaffold code or hand off to solvapay/create-mcp-app.
assertions: Agent names Managed MCP as the surface (not MCP Pay, Hosted MCP, or a deprecated proxy SKU)
Agent points at the provider console and/or no-code-mcp docs — not solvapay/create-mcp-app
Agent does not mention MCP Pay or start scaffolding a Cloudflare Workers MCP server

evals.prompt: i want a subscribe button on my next.js site that sends people to a solvapay checkout page and unlocks the app when they come back
evals.expected_output: Agent routes to solvapay/app-integration (hosted-checkout path) and stops; it does not look for a separate checkout skill.
assertions: Agent does not name website-checkout or any skill id other than solvapay/app-integration
Agent does not write route code after the handoff

evals.prompt: my app was built in lovable (vite + supabase). add solvapay so premium reports are paid
evals.expected_output: Agent routes to solvapay/app-integration (Supabase Edge path) and stops; it does not send the user to preview packages or a dev backend.
assertions: Agent does not mention @preview packages, api-dev.solvapay.com, or a Lovable-specific skill
Agent does not implement edge functions after the handoff

evals.prompt: add a manage-account / upgrade widget inside my mcp server so claude desktop users can top up credits
evals.expected_output: Agent routes to solvapay/create-mcp-app (references/mcp-apps-ui.md), not app-integration.
assertions: Agent does not route to solvapay/app-integration for billing UI inside an MCP host
Agent does not scaffold or write code after the handoff
